#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root="$HOME/ji-stage6-package-smoke"
runtime="$root/runtime"
data="$root/data"
locator="$root/host-locator"
log="$root/host.log"
if test -d "$root"; then
  docker run --rm -v "$root:/ji-cleanup" alpine:3.22 sh -eu -c 'rm -rf /ji-cleanup/* /ji-cleanup/.[!.]* /ji-cleanup/..?*'
  rmdir "$root"
fi
mkdir -p "$runtime" "$data"
tar -xzf "$HOME/ji-stage6-release/output/ji-host-linux-amd64-java21.tar.gz" --strip-components=1 -C "$runtime"
chmod 0755 "$runtime/bin/ji-host" "$runtime/runtime/bin/java"
pid=
cleanup() {
  if test -n "$pid" && kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
JI_HOST_BIND=127.0.0.1 \
JI_HOST_PORT=0 \
JI_HOST_HCP_PORT=0 \
JI_HOST_LOCATOR_FILE="$locator" \
JI_DATA_DIR="$data" \
JI_WORKSPACE_ROOT="$HOME" \
"$runtime/bin/ji-host" >"$log" 2>&1 &
pid=$!
attempts=0
while ! test -f "$locator"; do
  if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    wait "$pid" || true
    cat "$log"
    exit 1
  fi
  attempts=$((attempts + 1))
  if ! test "$attempts" -lt 60; then
    cat "$log"
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
done
rest=$(sed -n 's/^rest=//p' "$locator")
case "$rest" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1;; esac
"$runtime/bin/ji-host" --health-check "http://127.0.0.1:$rest/api/v1/health/ready"
printf 'STAGE6_PACKAGE_SMOKE_OK rest=%s\n' "$rest"
